name: Ferienwohnung Esterl
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Esterl is located in the municipality of Erl in the Tiroler Unterinntal, near the German border. The accommodation is situated in a quiet residential area and serves as a starting point for tours into the mountains of the Zahmer Kaiser. The apartment is equipped with a kitchenette and a bathroom. Parking is available directly at the house. The furnishings are functional and designed for the needs of self-caterers. The quiet location is suitable for guests seeking relaxation. From the accommodation, the nearby hiking trails, in winter the ski area Zahmer Kaiser, as well as the cultural offerings of Erl, such as the Passion Plays, can be reached.
